purpose: Crawl Ironman_Mode/Guide/* permanent unlocks, tools, and outfits; flag those missing from data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json and data/research/catalog.json as first-class permanent-unlock / equipment records (training-method footnotes do not count as ownership).

scope.in_app_rule: in_app is true only when a dedicated regional-skilling or catalog permanent-unlock/equipment record exists by name. Mentions inside training-method notes, XP rate footnotes, or planner expansions do not satisfy the permanent-unlock index. Superheat Form, sous chef, first age, botanist/factory, blacksmith, constructor/lumberjack, crystal tools, skillchompas, herb bag, scroll of cleansing, autoheater, ectofuntus outfit, master runecrafter, etc. are already indexed and excluded from this missing list.
scope.importance_sort: Ironman planner impact: multi-skill permanent boosts, self-sufficient tool/outfit chains, region-pick pressure, and guide Essential/Equipment-table callouts ranked above niche cosmetics.

already_present_high_value_examples: cross-region late tool chains (earth-and-song, ember-and-glade, bloom-and-blight, balarak, skeka, artificers-measure)

missing_unlocks.unlock_name: Slayer helmet craft + full upgrade chain
missing_unlocks.why: Ironman Slayer guide calls the helmet the most essential gear; craft learn costs 400 points after Smoking Kills; full/reinforced/corrupted upgrades + ring-fuse are permanent combat/skilling multipliers. Helmet part farms (black mask, focus sight, hexcrest, spectral lens) are multi-region. No dedicated permanent-unlock record in regional-skilling-unlocks or catalog equipment index.

missing_unlocks.why: Ironman Slayer notable rewards: 500 points each to attach drop-cleaners permanently. Items themselves partly exist (bonecrusher/seedicide/charming imp rows) but the permanent toolbelt-attach unlock is not indexed as a planner permanent.
